GPTR-F-001-S162.title: Core Allowlist Enforcement Engine
GPTR-F-001-S162.description: Implement the core enforcement engine that evaluates normalized GPTReader requests against the allowlist schema, rejecting any disallowed collections, fields, operators, or limit violations with deterministic error responses.

GPTR-F-001-S163.title: Secure Error and Response Contract
GPTR-F-001-S163.description: Define and implement a secure API response contract for enforcement failures that returns consistent error codes and messages without leaking internal schema or system details.

GPTR-F-001-S164.title: Unit and Negative Security Test Suite
GPTR-F-001-S164.description: Create comprehensive unit tests covering valid queries, rejected queries, boundary conditions, and adversarial inputs to verify strict allowlist enforcement and prevent bypass scenarios.

GPTR-F-001-S165.title: End-to-End Integration with Azure Function Endpoint
GPTR-F-001-S165.description: Integrate the allowlist enforcement engine into the Azure Function GPTReader endpoint, ensuring all incoming requests pass through validation before MongoDB access and preserving existing auth and audit flows.
